title: sambucus williamsii var. miquelii
intro: Sambucus williamsii var. miquelii, commonly known as Chinese elderberry, is a variety of the Sambucus williamsii plant, which is a flowering plant native to China and Japan. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, and is known to help alleviate symptoms of the common cold and flu. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus williamsii var. miquelii include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
